Peer route · Methodology

Root cause before recommendation. Evidence before confidence.

A practical method for keeping observed facts, calculations, assumptions, estimates and recommendations separate.

01

Map

Agree the journey boundary, events, owners and decision in scope.

02

Measure

Build the baseline and show evidence quality beside performance.

03

Diagnose

Test patterns, alternatives and where variability enters the system.

04

Rebuild

Prioritise the first intervention, owner and verification points.

Evidence ladder

Observed

Present in or directly traceable to the source record.

Calculated

Derived through a documented, repeatable formula.

Assumed

A business input reviewed and approved by the accountable owner.

Estimated

An opportunity range combining evidence with stated assumptions.

Recommended

A proposed intervention subject to operational judgement.

Stop

The correct conclusion when the evidence cannot justify the next step.

A focused first conversation

A useful diagnostic narrows the decision before it widens the programme.

No operational data is needed for the initial conversation.
